pages.title: Copper Tools
pages.text: $(bold)The stone axe, copper blocks and the lightning rod, and the beaten metal that makes a canteen and a water purifier. Glass bottles too. The Copper Age proper. +10% breaking speed.$(br2)$(thing)Copper Age$(n), ring 2.$(br)$(thing)8 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Quarry.
